# VartaLang

> VartaLang is India's language bridge — a free platform connecting people through Indian languages, language learning, speaking practice, and language-based opportunities.

## Learn

- [Language Guides](https://vartalang.in/learn): Curated learning guides for Indian and other supported languages, including recommended articles, books, YouTube channels, websites, and practice resources.
- [Language Challenge](https://vartalang.in/challenge): Record a short passage in an Indian language and get assessed on fluency.

## About

- [About VartaLang](https://vartalang.in/about): What VartaLang is and how it works.

## Opportunities

- [Jobs](https://vartalang.in/jobs): Language-related opportunities available through VartaLang.

## Account

- [Sign up](https://vartalang.in/auth/signup): Create a free VartaLang account.
- [Login](https://vartalang.in/auth/login): Sign in to an existing account.

## Paid Learning

- [VartaLang Learn](https://learn.vartalang.in): VartaLang's dedicated learning platform for structured paid courses and future Practice Labs.

## Private Areas

Pages such as matches, chats, profiles, administration, and other authenticated areas require a signed-in account and are not intended for crawling.
